property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list and any amount v and decimals d, if every external transferFrom call succeeds, then transfer returns true; if any call fails, transfer reverts.
For a one-element recipient list, if the external transferFrom call succeeds then transfer returns true; if it fails then transfer reverts.
For a single-recipient transferFrom call with zero value (v=0, decimals=0) that succeeds, transfer returns true; if the external call fails, transfer reverts.
For a single-recipient transferFrom call with a successful external call, transfer returns true; with a failing external call, transfer reverts.
For a single recipient, transfer returns true exactly when the external transferFrom call succeeds; otherwise it reverts.
For any non-empty list of recipients and any value, c.transfer either succeeds and returns true after making a successful transferFrom call to each recipient, or it reverts entirely.
For a single recipient, c.transfer returns true if and only if it does not revert, provided the callee supports transferFrom and enough allowance exists.
For a single recipient, c.transfer returns true whenever it succeeds (does not revert).
For a single recipient, c.transfer either reverts or returns true; it never returns false.
